class.name: Friends
class.description: Who the player's Steam friends are, whether they're playing this game, and the lobbies they're in, to join or invite them.

method.name: get_all
method.description: Returns the player's friends, each a [Dictionary] with [code]id[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]playing[/code] ([code]true[/code] when they're playing this game), [code]lobby[/code] (the code of the lobby they're in, for [method Lobbies.join], or empty) and [code]invited[/code] ([code]true[/code] when they invited this player to that lobby). Empty without Steam.

method.name: invite
method.description: Invites a friend (an [code]id[/code] from [method get_all]) to the current lobby. Steam tells them, and their game sees [code]invited[/code] in its list; accepting joins the lobby.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted when a friend's status or lobby changed, or they invited this player: time to call [method get_all] again.
